Get x axis parameters

x_axis_label_params.Rd

Takes the datapoints and config (for user xmin and xmax mainly) and calculates the ticmkark positions, the label positions, the default labels (not handling overlapping just yet) and the xlims for the x axis.

Usage

x_axis_label_params(
  datapoints,
  config,
  tickmarks,
  x_lims,
  bar,
  x_values,
  language = "si",
  interval_type = "annual"
)

Arguments

datapoints

list of dataframes from prep_data

config

dictionary list from prep_config

tickmarks

vector from from x_axis_lims_tickmarks

x_lims

vector from from x_axis_lims_tickmarks

bar

logical indicating it's a barplot

x_values

midpoints and params for interpolating

language

"si" or "en"z

interval_type

- annual (default) or monthly, from x_axis_lims_tickmarks

Value

list of named x_positions, x_labels, tickmars and x_lims

Details

Taking into account if the data is only annual - in which case the tickmarks and labels align - or monthly/quarterly in which case the labels are between. Taking into account if the last year is complete or not, which determines the last tickmark and label etc.
